articles.title: Binance tells EU users it will no longer provide services after failing to secure MiCA license
articles.snippet: A day after withdrawing its MiCA license application in Greece and saying it is ‘not leaving Europe,’ Binance notified users across the European Union that it will suspend some services.

articles.title: Too big to fail: Strategy’s $13 billion bitcoin paper loss alone dwarfs hundreds of prominent tokens
articles.snippet: Strategy’s paper loss exceeds the market caps of hundreds of tokens, highlighting the extreme concentration of risk in the crypto market right now.

articles.title: Asset management giant Invesco files for tokenized fund targeting stablecoin reserve market
articles.snippet: The $2.5 trillion asset manager deepens its blockchain push after taking over Superstate's tokenized money market fund as fund manager earlier this year.

articles.title: a16z-backed crypto firm rebrands, shifts focus to solving AI’s global copyright headache
articles.snippet: The startup formerly known as Story Protocol raised $140 million to secure internet rights and is now building an audit layer for data consent, licensing, and provenance for tech firms.

articles.title: Spain regulator rules out extension for non-MiCA compliant crypto companies
articles.snippet: Carlos San Basilio said that “there will be no exceptions ​or extensions” to the MiCA deadline requiring crypto exchanges offering services to EU-based users to be licensed.
